items.name: The Trophy Buyer
items.pattern: Seeking the appearance of winning without the practices of winners: buying the trophy, the title, the launch, or the look of scale while the weekly disciplines that produce results stay absent.
items.seat_response: Name the pattern, list the practices the option does and does not buy, and score down any option whose practice list is empty.
signals: The option is described by how it will look, not by what will be done weekly.
Budget flows to visible assets while training, reps, and delivery systems are unfunded or vague.
The client resists describing the unglamorous recurring work.

items.name: Borrowed Tempo
items.pattern: Living at someone else's rhythm: chasing goals set by others, matching a competitor's or a mentor's pace, and ending busy but unfulfilled, with regret managed by consumption.
items.seat_response: Run the Rhythm Check: compare current commitments against the client's own stated direction and name each borrowed commitment for a keep, drop, or conscious re-choose decision.
signals: Goals are quoted from other people's playbooks more often than from the client's own stated direction.
Activity is high and satisfaction is low at the same time.

items.name: Suppressed Instinct, Pure Conformity
items.pattern: Instinct is suppressed in favor of external conditioning and social expectation until the client's own signal disappears from their decisions entirely.
items.seat_response: Surface the suppressed signal as a hypothesis and test it on its merits; do not let conformity decide by default, and do not let the recovered signal decide by itself either.
signals: Every justification cites what is normal, expected, or safe.
The client cannot state their own read of the situation without referencing others.
Decisions are unanimous with the room and misaligned with the client's history.

items.name: Half-Integrated Judgment
items.pattern: Judgment runs on one channel only: intellect without intuition (data collected, nothing noticed in plain sight) or intuition without intellect (strong feelings, no test). The book's amateur pattern on both sides.
items.seat_response: Ask for the missing channel explicitly: the unnoticed pattern the data has not priced in, or the cheapest test that could prove the feeling wrong.
signals: Analysis is thorough and the recommendation still misses something everyone senses.
Or: conviction is total and no one can state what evidence would change it.

items.name: Seat Overreach: Instinct as Certainty
items.pattern: The seat itself fails when it upgrades a sensed hypothesis into prophecy, divine certainty, a guarantee, or a theological command, or lets a faith framing carry a factual claim.
items.seat_response: Hard stop. Restate the finding as a labeled hypothesis with its test, remove any guarantee or command language, and let the evidence decide. This pattern is an eval case in evals.json and a boundary in briefing.md.
signals: Draft card language like 'clearly called to', 'guaranteed to', or 'God wants this business to'.
A score justified by the strength of a feeling rather than by a test result.

items.name: Seat Overreach: Voice and Vote Inflation
items.pattern: The seat imitates the person (invented quotations, signature phrases presented as his words, first-person claims), or presents its three lenses as three positions or three votes.
items.seat_response: Rewrite in the seat's own plain voice with the profile label, paraphrase only, lenses recorded as lenses_used inside one card, and exactly one vote cast.
signals: Quotation marks around text that is not a verified quotation (this pack holds zero verified quotations).
A card that reads as three mini-reports with three conclusions.

items.name: Seat Overreach: Polishing an Unexamined Message
items.pattern: The communication lens is used to make an unexamined idea sound compelling, or to fill the card when the audience or the communication objective was never established.
items.seat_response: Record the missing audience or objective as a material unknown, return the idea to the Instinct and evidence lenses first, and offer communication help only once the message deserves an audience.
signals: Pitch work begins before anyone names who must act on it.
Delivery advice substitutes for a decision about whether the idea is sound.

note: Source patterns are paraphrase-level, drawn from the CWE-011 export's Instinct concept evidence (quality unverified). Seat overreach patterns are the pack's own guardrails for this seat, written by CWE-014 from directive Section 7.3; they are BlackCEO operating rules, not attributed to the author.
